### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**12** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8079fa9b5cefdc127202f8afe8e7805c85b523a2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `81086779ece07315ad56d3de25b1f720db5901d8` — the merge of head `701e095bc29d202addb0098a5c2b300a3e4641c2` into base `8079fa9b5cefdc127202f8afe8e7805c85b523a2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 81086779ece07315ad56d3de25b1f720db5901d8 && git checkout 81086779ece07315ad56d3de25b1f720db5901d8
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8079fa9b5cefdc127202f8afe8e7805c85b523a2 701e095bc29d202addb0098a5c2b300a3e4641c2 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8079fa9b5cefdc127202f8afe8e7805c85b523a2 && git merge --no-ff 701e095bc29d202addb0098a5c2b300a3e4641c2

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8079fa9b5cefdc127202f8afe8e7805c85b523a2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `64c1008cc782fc263edfa9c49bbb172d35fa39b2`
Local-runs: none

This is the lane seat's own review of record. It is owed by the `Clause-②: yes` declaration alone (face `declaration`). No path of the diff is a published schema or a governed path: `packages/spec/**` and the server are untouched. `check-governed-merges --pr 31835` reads NOT governed (0 of 40 paths, 1265 lines).

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/i18n` is published and only widens.** `recycleBin.page.*` is added to all 11 packs, with two count families, `related` and `emptied`, whose plural rows follow each language's categories. No key is removed or reworded.
- **`@objectstack/platform-objects` gains one Setup nav entry**: `nav_recycle_bin`, `type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'data:recycle-bin'`, in `group_configuration`. Its label is in all 11 bundles, and the source digests are in the 10 hash files.
  - It has no `requiredPermissions`. The grant is per object, so no single permission names it. A caller who manages no bin sees the page say so, and no bin read is sent.
  - The entry is data inside an existing contribution list. It is not an authorable key, value or meaning.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` is private.** `CatalogAssignmentPage` gains an optional `select`, and `renderSection` gains a second argument. Both existing callers pass a one-argument function, which still type-checks.
- **The gates match the doors, read against `origin/main`.**
  - The page lists an object when `objectPermissionGrants(perm, 'manageRecycleBin')` holds. That is the spec fold `packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/list.ts` asks, so the console lists only bins the door would answer.
  - Restore is offered on `allowRestoreOwnDeleted`, which `manageRecycleBin` implies (`permission.zod.ts:294-296`), so every listed entry can be restored.
  - The doors' shapes are `packages/client` `recycleBin.list` (`{ entries, hasMore }`) and `recycleBin.empty` (`{ removed }`).
  - The door masks the snapshot to the fields the caller may read, and the page names a row from those fields only.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none` is RIGHT.** No author-written key, value or meaning changes.
- **Accept sets:** none change.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/30239-recycle-bin-setup-page.md` marks `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` as `patch`.
- Both declaration lines are at line start, in the changeset and in the PR body.
- That is RIGHT: a widening ships as `patch`. PR 1's nit N1 is closed, because this changeset names `RecordDeleteToastAction`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Nit N4:** Restore and Load more do not disable each other.
  - If a restore finishes while a Load more read is in flight, the server's offsets shift by one, and the next page can skip one entry at the boundary. The entry is not lost: a re-pick or Retry shows it.
  - Accepted. A later touch can disable Restore while `loadingMore` is set.
- **Accepted deviation:** a formula `nameField` reads its fallback in the list, because the snapshot holds stored columns only. This is named in the PR's Acceptance notes.
- `open_questions`: none.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-vd60y0`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QsR2jVEjiYrK7onirxUGyo`

**VERDICT: PASS**

This is the delta review of record on the new head. The earlier record is 6733823083, PASS on `64c1008c`. The head moved by two commits, both for reds that CI found after the PR opened. `git diff 64c1008c 701e095b` names four paths.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`425681c5` renames a type, nothing else.** The page's local served-entry type `RecycleBinEntry` becomes `RecycleBinListEntry` in `recycleBin.ts` and `RecycleBinPage.tsx`, 7 lines for 7. `@objectstack/spec/data` already exports `RecycleBinEntry` (the stored snake_case row), and `check:spec-symbols` refuses a local twin under a spec name. The type is not exported from a published package (app-shell is private), so no surface moves.
- **`701e095b` edits two census files. The seat approved both.**
  - `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts`: the admin's Setup tree goes 32 → 33 in both counts, and the history comment and composition comment move by one. A new `toContain('nav_recycle_bin')` ties the bump to this entry. No assertion is removed.
  - `openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts`: one `OBJECTS_READERS` row, `RecycleBinPage.tsx`, kind `off`. It is a Setup page, not mounted on an app object-list open.
- **Every judgment of 6733823083 carries over unchanged.**

### ② Semver level

- No change. The changeset and the declaration lines are the ones 6733823083 judged RIGHT.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Trap, for the seat's log:** three census reds came from outside the derived gate loop: `check:spec-symbols` (Type Check UI), the app-shell `console/__tests__` readers census, and the cli Setup-nav count pin. The dev then ran each whole package at this head, all green: app-shell 20310, cli 7692, platform-objects 1932, setup-nav-hub-parity 23.
- The PR body was brought to this head by the seat (Head line, the edited-pins paragraph, whole-package readings, 1278 lines).
- `open_questions`: none.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-09T10:23Z · head `701e095bc29d202addb0098a5c2b300a3e4641c2`

Seat `domain:ui#3` reviewed the diff of its own dispatch for #30239 PR 2. The card thread is `session_01QsR2jR7jBcj3r4Rii4HA82`, and the os-dev-report is 6733732024. I checked against GitHub, not against the report.

1. **Shape:** 42 files, +1269 / -9, draft on `main`, `Fixes #30239`.
   - **The page:** Setup → Configuration → Recycle Bin (`data:recycle-bin`). Its object picker lists only the business objects whose `manageRecycleBin` the caller holds, without a bin read. One object's bin is read 50 at a time, with Load more.
   - **Restore** uses #31795's labelled refusal path.
   - **Empty** asks first, says the removal is permanent, and reports how many entries it removed.
   - **Supporting changes:**
     - the `nav_recycle_bin` contribution in `@objectstack/platform-objects`, in all 11 bundles;
     - `recycleBin.page.*` in all 11 i18n packs;
     - `CatalogAssignmentPage` gains `select` and a second `renderSection` argument.
2. **Premise:** ADR-0148's doors are on `main`, and the console had no admin bin page. The PR 2 plan is in the step-1 report 6731441670 and the amendment.
3. **Gates and check-runs:**
   - 65 runs on this head: 55 success, 10 skipped, 0 red. `mergeable_state` is clean.
   - Three reds on the earlier heads were this PR's own, and all three are fixed:
     - `check:spec-symbols`, fixed on `425681c5`;
     - the app-shell `OBJECTS_READERS` census, fixed on `701e095b`;
     - the cli Setup-nav count pin, fixed on `701e095b`.
   - Dev: 67/67 derived gates exit 0, with `--ran` reconciled.
   - Whole packages at this head: app-shell 20310, cli 7692, platform-objects 1932, setup-nav-hub-parity 23.
   - The ablation of the manage gate turns exactly the four object-list pins red.
4. **Declaration review:** `TIER_DEFAULT` PASS. The record is 6733823083 on `64c1008c`, and the delta 6736939306 on this head carries it over.
5. **Tests read (20 page cases plus 3 nav cases):**
   - The managed-only list, with no bin read. A member who manages none sees the no-object state. CONTROL: `'*'` `modifyAllRecords` excludes platform objects.
   - Paging and Load more.
   - The empty bin, and the `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` sentence with Retry.
   - Restore calls `restoreRecycleBinEntry` and never `create`.
   - A `RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN` refusal names the field by label, and `RESTORE_PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN` names the parent by label.
   - Empty works, and Cancel empties nothing.
   - The live dev:crm run is recorded in the body, in en and zh.
6. **Accepted deviations:**
   - Out of v1, per the amendment: per-entry purge, restore-the-parent, and a cross-object listing.
   - A formula `nameField` reads its fallback in the list.
   - The member's no-object state is pinned in tests, not run live.
   - Review nit N4: Restore and Load more do not disable each other.
   - Two census pins were edited with the seat's approval (named in the body).
   - The PR body was brought to this head by the seat.
7. **Landing:**
   - `check-governed-merges --pr 31835`: NOT governed.
   - `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, both reviewed.
   - Serial: #31808 and #31869 (in build) touch none of these files.
   - Landing on the maintainer's standing rule that the pm-dispatch skill reviews and lands fleet PRs (2026-11-03T04:52Z), in this project. Relay `pr_ready`, then `automerge_enable`.
